name: Journey North
detailed_description:
From the inspiration of games like Banjo Kazooie comes Journey North, a third person adventure puzzle game. Take control of Liam as he takes the adventure of a lifetime. Discover what is hiding in the woods behind his house.

       Explore your way through a giant mushroom forest will helping the local Gnomes.

Help them restore the Runes that the Beast of the North disrupted in their villages. Collect items and complete puzzles to help you on your journey.

      Taking inspiration from old school games Journey North is filled with the humor and chard to keep you playing again and again. This game takes small worlds with a Nordic twist to make it have a fast pace feel but not a rushed experience.

Game play lore

When Liam wandered beyond the backyard and into the woods behind his parents' house, he wasn’t looking for an adventure. He was just a curious kid with a backpack full of snacks and a head full of questions. But when he slipped through a crack in the earth and into a hidden cave, everything changed.

Beneath the surface, Liam discovers a forgotten world, a glowing mushroom forest teeming with gnomes, odd creatures, and ancient secrets. The gnomes are in trouble: their villages are crumbling, their rune stone the heart of their magic has been stolen, and a mysterious force known only as The Beast of the North is sowing chaos throughout the land.

Drawn into their struggle, Liam must solve strange puzzles, help rebuild what’s been broken, and uncover the truth behind the beast's anger. But the deeper he journeys, the more he realizes this isn’t just a quest to save the gnomes, it’s a journey into himself, where forgotten feelings and difficult truths wait in the shadows of memory.

Key features

  • Experience a giant mushroom forest right out of a fantasy novel

  • Complete puzzles and challenges to help you on your journey north to confront the Beast

  • An old school feeling game to bring back the nostalgia of the past

        Journey North is a gaming experience sure to bring you back to the good old days.
